rationale: Secondary pooled knockout screen (library CP1547: about 250 murine genes chosen from the whole-genome screen x 8 guides, guides against human CALR and MPL, and non-targeting NO_SITE and intergenic ONE_INTERGENIC_SITE controls) in BA/F3-MPL cells; one GEO sample (GSM6172300) holds a PoolQ count table. The paper's main comparison (Figure 2D-E, supplemental Table 3 sheet DEL-_vs_EV+) is CALR del52 cells without IL3 against empty-vector cells with IL3 at day 21, four independent biological replicate lines each. Replicate lines are independent per genotype, so they are not paired across arms. The single EV#2 without-IL3 library is a viability control (cells die) and is left out. Both control classes are used as controls; the intergenic guides cut, which suits a knockout screen. Because the library is focused on expected hits, a large share of genes may be depleted, so library totals are checked against the controls (see report). Gene labels come from the deposited chip file (prepare.R).
